premises.text: Electrical lighting drives large CO2 emissions, electricity use, and light pollution
premises.evidence_span: Electrical lighting is responsible for 1.7 billion tons of CO2 emissions, is 15% of global electricity consumption, and more than 80% of humans are affected by light pollution

premises.text: A growing living bioluminescent material can replace electrical lighting with natural light
premises.evidence_span: We created a growing and living raw material, bioluminescence material, in order to reduce the environmental impact

premises.text: Glow Events provide ephemeral lighting up to one week; Pipelight provides continuous maintained glowing light
premises.evidence_span: The first one is called Glow Events, and it's an ephemeral light to light temporal spaces, and it can light up to one week. The second one is Pipelight. It's a continuous lighting system

premises.text: Liquid patented bioluminescent solution fills arbitrary casings and delivers unique wavelength with health benefits
premises.evidence_span: our light can take basically any shape, any kind of casing, because it's a liquid solution

premises.text: Bacteria engineered for bioluminescence are grown, mixed with waste-derived nutrients, and housed in transparent shells
premises.evidence_span: we feed our microbes with waste coming from different kinds of industries

premises.text: Technology is licensed to energy-provider partners who operate installations to scale
premises.evidence_span: we are partnering with energy providers. So we license to them our technology, and they operate the system

premises.text: Events educate and raise awareness as a path toward continuous Pipelight outdoor and hospitality deployments
premises.evidence_span: events are great because they educate people. They raise consumer awareness

value.text: Grow biological light that reduces environmental impact while improving wellness and design possibilities
value.evidence_span: reduce the environmental impact, to improve wellness thanks to the quality of this natural light, and to offer a lot of new design possibilities

secondary_value.text: Close the loop with waste-fed microbes yielding unlimited light and organic byproducts
secondary_value.evidence_span: we have an unlimited light resource and some neutral or valuable 100% organic byproducts so that we can really close that loop

causal_links.evidence_span: Why can't we just grow our own light?
bioluminescence material, in order to reduce the environmental impact, to improve wellness
for us, it's an amazing way to scale
this is a strategy to go from events to a revolution

notes: Glow Events and Pipelight kept as one product-line premise (two form factors of the living light). Gene insert/engineer/grow cascade folded into the biotech process with waste-nutrient loop. LED rare-metal critique treated as framing for the bio alternative, not a separate premise. Unit sales and press features excluded as traction.
